links.outcome: GP diagnosis and treatment plan changes when blinded versus unblinded to AI app assessment
links.effect: GPs never changed their working diagnosis but changed their treatment plan in 5 patients based on the app's assessments; 45 of 50 GP assessments completed successfully.
links.quote: GPs never changed their working diagnosis, but did change their treatment plan (n = 5) based on the app's assessments.

unlisted_practices: Patient-facing AI app used before the GP visit to triage skin lesions and possibly cancel visits
Mixed-methods feasibility assessment of barriers and facilitators to AI app implementation in primary care

screen.reason: Prospective feasibility study evaluating real-world implementation of a patient-facing AI mobile app for skin cancer detection and its influence on GP consultations.
